symptom: A non-interrupting timer could not repeat: MDL had no spelling for Studio Pro's recurring reminder, mxcli always wrote Recurrence: null, and a describe -> create or modify turned a Studio Pro reminder into a one-shot timer (the #1713 refusal). A timer-started event sub-process's recurrence was neither written nor read
cause: No grammar for Workflows$LinearRecurrence; the writers hard-coded null; the reader skipped it; the vendored metamodel predates the event sub-process start types, so their Recurrence was not even known
file: `mdl/grammar/MDLLexer.g4` (REPEAT, EVERY, TIMES, usable as names), `mdl/grammar/domains/MDLWorkflow.g4` (workflowRecurrence on boundary timers and timer event sub-process starts; workflowTimerDelay predicate), `sdk/workflows/workflow.go` (Recurrence, RecurrenceIntervalType), `mdl/backend/modelsdk/workflow_write.go` + `workflow_read.go`, `mdl/backend/wfmutator/mutator.go` + `mcp/workflow.go` + `mock` (InsertBoundaryEvent recurrence), `mdl/executor/validate_workflow_recurrence.go` (MDL-WF22), `mdl/executor/version_gates.go` + `sdk/versions/mendix-11.yaml` (recurring_timer_event_subprocesses 11.15)
insight: The IntervalType values are not in the vendored metamodel and mx check validates neither them nor the bounds (it accepted 'Bogus'), so mx check could not establish anything. Two sources inside the mxbuild distribution did: the runtime jar's enum (com.mendix.model.scheduledevents.ModelIntervalType, javap: stringValue Second..Year) gave the stored strings, and the Studio Pro web model bundle (modeler/ide-client/registry/main.js — grep the property name) gave the schema defaults and the validation Studio Pro applies (MW0004 maxExecutions >= 2 counting the first occurrence, MW0005 Minute/Hour/Day/Week/Month only). Then a runtime boot settled what mx check could not: on 11.13 the boundary recurrence fired 3 of 3 but the event sub-process start fired once — `strings` on the 11.13 workflows-metamodel.jar showed ModelNonInterruptingTimerEventSubProcessStartActivity has no recurrence there, 11.15's does — a version gap mx check cannot see. Making repeat/every/times keywords needed the delay predicate (`timer repeat …` would read `repeat` as the delay) and the keyword-as-name list; MCP refuses a recurrence because PED's timer constructors drop what they do not take
fix: `repeat every <n> <unit> at most <m> times` after a non-interrupting timer's delay (boundary event, alter insert) and after a timer event sub-process start's expression (gated 11.15); writer emits Workflows$LinearRecurrence, reader returns it, describe prints it; MDL-WF22 refuses an interrupting timer, a unit other than minute..month, interval < 1 and fewer than 2 executions; the #1713 rewrite refusal drops its recurrence row
